part.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the end and stopped about 0.6 m from the red wall. It said it had arrived and is now resting in a crouch with the motors off.

The route had four 90° turns: left, right, left, left. In total it walked about 9.6 m forward and 10.9 m to the side, measured from where it started. It didn't fall or bump into anything on the way.

When the robot crouched for rest, it turned about 9° to the left. It's still facing the red wall.
